name: Kujou Ruri
source: The student council president. Her father is president of school and coming from wealthy family believes she should be on top of pyramid for others to obey. As student president enacted a love ban because she was angry how others could get lovers but she couldn't. She is jealous of others and refuses to lift ban for fear of looking stupid.
